provenance: Original synthetic teaching fixtures; no observed market data or investment recommendation.

conventions.property: Annual dates 0,1,2,3; no tax; quoted par debt; interest on opening principal; full repayment without refinancing or default; sale after date-3 operations uses date-4 NOI.
conventions.smoothing: Population moments assume stationary geometric filter and jointly iid latent/market returns; finite path has separately fixed initial appraisal return; simple returns, not log returns.
conventions.private: Commitment covers investment capital only; annual fees at dates 1,2,3 on original commitment; terminal-only carry on positive gross distributions less investment capital, excluding management fees; remaining commitment released at 3.
conventions.liquidity: No interest, borrowing or sale of gated NAV; initial call at 0; each year income then spending then contribution before distribution; negative diagnostic balances are unfunded, not loans.
conventions.futures: Three model periods, not annualized; fixed units and multiplier 1; interest on all opening cash then variation settlement then opening-NAV management fee then performance fee then margin test; roll after date-1 settlement; final positions close after date-3 test.
